Prerequisite: Must have Army of the Dictator

If a creature fails their saving throw against your pseudo-domain by 5 or more, the damage is treated as having the Limb Removing Effect and targets one of their arms or legs.

system.requirements: Must have Army of the Dictator

jjk5e.automationNotes: Failing the pseudo-domain save by 5+: roll on the Limb Damage table (JJK panel).
